title: Reacquire session lease
goal: Reacquire the session lease for the current owner, minting a fresh token and a new fence (ADR-0029 §8.1).

sessionId.description: Session ID whose lease is reacquired.

ownerId.description: Current lease owner (agentId); reacquisition is owner-bound.

tokenHash.description: SHA-256 digest of the current lease token, proving current ownership (may be expired).

submissionCriteria: session exists and is not terminal
ownerId and tokenHash match the current lease owner and digest
